overloads.semanticRole: The SQL EXPORT SELECTION command exports in SQL format the records of the current selection of the 4D table designated by the aTable parameter.

constraints: Unlike SQL EXPORT DATABASE, this command only works with the main (internal) database, not an external SQL database, and it does not support Object type fields.
Exports only the current selection of aTable, not the entire database; if the current selection is empty, the command does nothing and the destination folder is not emptied.
The OK system variable is set to 1 if the export completes correctly, otherwise 0.
If folderPath is an empty string, a standard folder-selection dialog box is displayed, as for SQL EXPORT DATABASE.
